retrievalProfile.description: A tight, centered portrait of a woman with a voluminous 1960s bouffant hairstyle, featuring vibrant psychedelic display typography across the top.

recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up studio portrait of a Black woman with a large, textured bouffant hairstyle, set against a dark, atmospheric background with a burst of light behind the head. The top of the frame is occupied by stylized, colorful display text with a heavy drop shadow.
coreVisualRelationships: The hair volume creates a circular frame for the face
The text follows the curve of the hair's upper boundary
The pink of the clothing matches the highlights in the typography
The dark background provides high contrast for the subject's skin and hair texture
coreInvariants: Voluminous, textured bouffant hairstyle as the primary visual mass
Psychedelic display typography with high-contrast outlines

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is centered and fills approximately 70% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the large mass of the hair.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the vibrant text at the top, down through the hair texture to the subject's face, ending at the pink garment.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dark, mottled background concentrated in the lower corners and behind the hair.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep browns and blacks in the hair and background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant magenta/pink in the clothing and text.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Gold in the jewelry and text outlines.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the pinks against low-value, earthy tones.
paletteRestrictions: Stick to warm earth tones and magenta

letterConstructionRules: Thick, rounded strokes with minimal counters
Heavy drop shadows creating a 3D effect
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters like 'A' and 'O' have tiny, circular counters

composition.relationshipToImage: layered over background, following hair contour

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single dominant display face with small technical metadata in a sans-serif.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of a Black woman with a very large, curly 1960s bouffant hairstyle, wearing a pink top with gold trim and large hoop earrings, against a dark mottled background with a soft light halo behind her head.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply custom psychedelic bubble lettering in a magenta-to-purple gradient with a cyan outline and a heavy dark drop shadow, arched across the top of the frame.

verificationChecks: Is the hair the most prominent visual element?
Does the text have a 3D bubble effect?
Is the color palette dominated by brown and magenta?
Is the framing a tight headshot?

mustRedesign: Avoid modern digital sharpness; maintain a soft, film-grain texture
Ensure typography does not use standard modern sans-serifs
postGenerationChecks: Verify the drop shadow direction on text
Ensure the hair texture is detailed and not a flat shape
Confirm the pink color is vibrant and saturated
Check that the background is sufficiently dark to make the subject pop
recipe.reuseFormula: Vintage Soul Portrait = (Tight Bouffant Headshot + Dark Mottled Background) + (Arched Psychedelic Bubble Typography * Heavy Drop Shadow)
